services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: We have the perfect Siesta Key Boat Rental for any group. We rent runabouts, center consoles, deck boats, and pontoon boats and offer half day and all day boat rentals from 8 am to 5 pm daily. Our boat rentals run from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. through miles of Sarasota’s most beautiful intercoastal waterways. The route reveals Sarasota’s natural beauty with tropical trees, flowers, and exotic birds all alongside mangroves, sandbars, and beaches. Our docks are located behind our Sarasota Store on Siesta Key. Rental customers NEED at least two years of experience, and be at least 26 years of age. Renters born after January 1, 1988 are required by law to have a boater’s license. The BoatUS

blurb: CB's Saltwater Outfitters offers boat rentals, fishing charters, parasailing, jet ski rentals, and golf cart rentals. They also have a large bait and tackle shop and sell outdoor sportswear. The business has been a landmark in Sarasota since 1959 and serves the sports fishing community.
